_comment: Corrections for rows that are wrong in the AccessMedicine source itself. Key = analyte name as produced by parse_lab_values; 'set' = fields of the Analyte model to overwrite; 'why' = the evidence. Applied before the factor consistency check, so a correction must make the row consistent with its own reference intervals.

Urea nitrogen (BUN).why: Source prints 0.0357, but its own intervals (8-23 mg/dL = 2.9-8.2 mmol/L) and the molar mass of urea nitrogen (2 x 14.007 g/mol -> 10/28.014 = 0.357) give 0.357.

Lamotrigine.why: Source prints μg/dL, but factor 3.91 = 1000/256.1 g/mol converts μg/mL to μmol/L, and 2.5-15 μg/mL is the therapeutic range.

Glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase.why: Source prints U/mol Hb with factor 0.0645, but 1 U/g Hb x 64500 g/mol = 64500 U/mol Hb = 0.0645 MU/mol Hb.
